test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: X and Y, working together, can complete a work in 30 days, Y and Z, working together, can complete the same work in 40 days, and Z and X, working together, can complete the same work in 24 days. In how many days can X, Y and Z, working together, complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

X and Y complete the work in 30 days.

Y and Z can complete the work in 40 days.

X and Z can complete the work in 24 days.

**Concept Used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Total Work = LCM(30, 40, 24) = 120

Efficiency of X and Y = 120/30 = 4

Efficiency of Y and Z = 120/40 = 3

Efficiency of X and Z = 120/24 = 5

Efficiency of X, Y and Z = 12/2 = 6

Days taken by all three to complete the work = 120/6 = 20 days

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
